title: 1721 Prairie's 1863 frame house stands again behind its brick front
items: Wirt Dexter's original frame house now stands behind the brick front at 1721 Prairie, matched to the Detroit print of the Pullman house: two gabled wings with two-storey bay windows either side of an arched porch and front door, a shuttered window over the porch, bracketed eaves and four tall chimneys.

Built in clapboard from the timber kit, which can now hang louvred shutters beside a window and give a house several chimneys; how far the wings stand out and the paint are liberties, and the part the brick front was moved onto in 1902 is not rebuilt.
